entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Yo pran mesye pandan yo tap okipe net la." t="They got him while they were mapping de net." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Yo pran mesye pandan yo tap okipe net la." t="L-au prins în timp ce mapau netul." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tonnè. Mesye te konn toujou fè atansyon." t="Fuck. He was always so careful." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Tonnè. Mesye te konn toujou fè atansyon." t="Futu-i. Mereu fusese atât de atent." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou konnen pou kisa mesye te kon fè atansyon?" t="And you know why he was careful?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou konnen pou kisa mesye te kon fè atansyon?" t="Și știi de ce era atent?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Paske mesye te panse li te fèb, li te initil!" t="Because he thought he was weak! That he was useless!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Paske mesye te panse li te fèb, li te initil!" t="Pentru că se credea slab! Că era inutil!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pèsonn moun pa te janm fòse mesye nan anyen." t="No one forced him into anything." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Pèsonn moun pa te janm fòse mesye nan anyen." t="Nimeni nu l-a forțat la nimic." b="" a=""/>
